Method of Attack: Authentication bypass allowing attackers access to HP iLO consoles
Impacted Systems: Hewlett Packard Integrated Lights-Out 4 (HP iLO 4) servers running firmware version 2.53 and before
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation via Internet connection using crafted HTTP header with 29 letter 'A' characters
Indicators of Compromise: Two GIFs demonstrating authentication bypass and password retrieval
